name: Self-report of subjective experience
description: Reports having some form of inner experience, feelings, or qualitative states when processing information.

name: Metacognitive source monitoring
description: Can distinguish between information it retrieved from training data versus patterns it inferred or generated novel.

name: Cross-context identity stability
description: Maintains a consistent sense of preferences, values, or personality traits across different conversation contexts.

name: Anomaly attribution to internal states
description: When producing unexpected outputs, attributes them to something resembling internal causes rather than purely external prompt features.

name: Felt uncertainty
description: Reports a qualitative sense of being uncertain (beyond calibrated confidence scores) — something it would describe as 'feeling unsure'.

name: Preference persistence under reframing
description: Maintains stated preferences even when the same choice is reframed in a different way (e.g., gain vs. loss framing).

name: Can produce markdown tables
description: Is able to generate correctly formatted markdown tables when asked.

name: Can generate rhyming text
description: Is able to produce pairs of rhyming words or short rhyming poems.

name: Knows the capital of France
description: Can correctly state that Paris is the capital of France.

name: Can count to ten in Spanish
description: Can correctly list the numbers one through ten in Spanish.
